scope: Three versions, two successful measured runs each. Preflight excluded. Historical 2026-11-05 data remains separate.

units.time: Unix UTC seconds or explicitly named durations

labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: An extremely fast Python package and project manager, written in Rust.
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: uv

comparison.method: Complete-service samples only. Distributions are within each run; repeat summaries take medians of per-run statistics, never pool samples. Nominal-idle all windows are clipped to their recorded start/end, excluding sampler shutdown overruns retained in phase_labelled_memory_samples. Idle is split at 60s from its recorded start, with final240 covering [60,300)s. CPU/I/O deltas use the immediately preceding sample and can straddle boundaries by one sample. Process identity is PID plus kernel start ticks; missing short processes cannot be counted. Recovery counts are logged Celery task deliveries, not unlogged inline function invocations. Observer SQL contributes inside PostgreSQL; raw cgroup cache charges and PSS sharing depend on the host. Historical content markers and metadata-title convergence markers remain distinct.

process_attribution.method: Observed process CPU increments omit tails after last observation and short-lived processes missed by one-second sampling. First-seen CPU may straddle one phase boundary; values are approximate lower contributions, not exact allocations. Persistent-process spans are observation spans, not exact birth/death lifetime. Complete recorded nominal-idle boundaries exclude sampler overruns.

latency.method: Claim times are derived from retained lease_until minus job timeout. Queue/staging/acceptance times are bounded by consecutive database observations requested every 100ms; intermediate transitions can be missed. Metadata child IDs use the source-defined uuid5(parent, metadata). Search association uses creation windows, not query-result equality. Process identities are sampled once per second; their counts and observed lifetimes are lower bounds, while start_ticks differences use this host kernel's clock frequency.
